project.name: solar-sales-desk
project.productType: Solar sales CRM and operations dashboard

typography.style: Readable business interface with tabular numerals

spacing.density: compact tables and controls; comfortable page-level spacing

must: Use saved application state for all customer records and metrics
Keep calling gated by recorded consent, an agreed schedule, provider readiness and allowance
Keep admin approval gates for customer-facing quotations and invoices
Make tables, filters and actions keyboard accessible and responsive
Label demo or local preview mode clearly
avoid: Invented leads, metrics, costs, conversion scores or testimonials
Animated or destructive bulk actions that do not fit the product workflow
Large empty dashboard panels that push priority information below the fold

decisions.prompt: Design Solar Sales Desk as a high-trust solar sales operations workspace: warm off-white canvas, deep forest navigation, restrained solar-gold highlights, dense readable tables with clear status chips, real-record search and filters, concise KPI cards, and responsive priority actions. Preserve explicit consent, calling readiness, and administrator approval gates. Use only actual saved business data and show empty states instead of sample customer records.

references.title: 21st.dev Leads Data Table pattern (structure only)
references.used: Compact CRM table hierarchy, clear stage and source presentation; implementation uses SolarDesk state and does not reuse sample records or destructive demo actions.

references.title: 21st.dev Revenue Charts and KPI pattern (visual reference)
references.used: Concise KPI grouping and restrained chart framing.
